audience: engineering and support teams who run a public status page with Status.io

useCases.title: Check the current state of your status page
useCases.text: The AI reads the overall status, every component and container with its status, open incidents and upcoming maintenance in one view.

useCases.title: Review active or resolved incidents and their updates
useCases.text: The AI lists active or resolved incidents with their messages and affected components, and opens one incident in full.

useCases.title: See pending, active or finished maintenance
useCases.text: The AI lists maintenance events by state, pending, active or closed, with messages and affected components.

useCases.title: Open an incident, post updates and resolve it
useCases.text: The AI opens an incident on the public status page, posts update messages with state and component status, and resolves it with a closing message. Notifications go out only if you switch them on.

useCases.title: Schedule, start and finish a maintenance event
useCases.text: The AI schedules a planned maintenance event, starts it, posts status messages and finishes it, so visitors see the right state at each step.

useCases.title: Change a component's public status
useCases.text: The AI sets a component and container to a status such as degraded_performance without creating an incident, and back to operational later.
